text:
Maya R: Heads up — last night webinar signup spike (x3) caused a backlog in HubSpot -> claim queue. Round-robin stalled and we see ~45m unowned leads. Weekend SLA is 30m, so we breached. Can we discuss a short patch to a heartbeat or fallback owner? cc @Sam @Olivia
Sam L: Ugh, saw that. Logs show enrichment webhooks timing out, then claim service waiting for enrich result before assigning.
Olivia P: Is this the same enrich TTL we increased last month? If so, revert to 2m for weekend hours?
Alex C: Quick idea: add a lightweight heartbeat that marks lead as "eligible-for-assign" after Xs of webhook delay, then round-robin to oncall pool. Minimal change in routing service.
Maya R: That sounds good. Priority: avoid duplicate claims + minimize churn. Can heartbeat set a flag and let idempotent assigner skip if enrich arrives later?
Alex C: Yes, assigner is idempotent. Pseudocode I tested:```
// if enrichment pending > 120s mark fallback=true
if (now - enrich.created_at > 120000 && !lead.flags.fallback_assigned) {
  lead.flags.fallback_assigned = true
  enqueueAssign(lead, fallbackPool)
}
```
Sam L: Can we scope to weekend hours and to webinars tag only? Reduce blast radius.
Olivia P: Agree. Also recommend small metric: count of fallback_assigns, time-to-first-claim, and duplicates. Will add to dashboard.
Maya R: Who can push the config? Need a hotfix that: 1) sets heartbeat threshold to 120s for tag:webinar between 00:00-08:00 UTC, 2) route fallback to oncall pool, 3) add metric.
Alex C: I can open the PR and patch the router. Will aim for a staged deploy to dev -> canary -> prod. PR description will include roll-back steps.
Sam L: I'll coordinate the dashboard and alert (SLO breach when unowned leads > 10 for 30m).
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for routing-hotfix by Alex C at 2024-11-03T04:10:00Z — watch: #deploys.
Maya R: Nice. Post-deploy check: please confirm 1) no duplicate assignments, 2) fallback_assign metric increments, 3) claim latency back under 30m. If all good, we'll keep for weekend then evaluate.
Olivia P: I'll run a replay test with webinar CSV and simulate enrichment timeouts to validate. ETA 90m.
Alex C: PR: https://git.redwood/routers/pull/432 — patch uploaded, running unit tests. Will ping when canary is live.
Sam L: Added dashboard panels and alert rule.
Maya R: Thanks team — this patch should buy us margin for the weekend launch. Follow up in this thread with canary results. :thumbsup:
